data.case_title: Electricity dunning notice (Mahnung) – Beispiel Energie Nordost
data.title: Dunning notice and threat of electricity disconnection (Mahnung und Androhung der Unterbrechung der Stromversorgung)
data.summary: Beispiel Energie Nordost GmbH demands payment of €198.50 — unpaid electricity advance payments (Abschläge) for February and March 2025 plus a €2.50 dunning fee — for the supply point at Ahornring 9, due by 23 April 2025, and warns it may have the grid operator interrupt the electricity supply if payment does not arrive.
data.explanation: This is a second payment reminder (Mahnung) from your electricity supplier, following an earlier Zahlungserinnerung from 24 March 2025. You owe €198.50 in total: two missed monthly advance payments plus a €2.50 dunning fee. Pay this amount by 23 April 2025 to the IBAN given, quoting your Vertragskonto if possible. If you don't pay in time, the supplier is entitled under § 19 StromGVV to have the grid operator cut off your electricity no earlier than four weeks after this letter, giving you at least eight working days' notice of the exact date; you would also have to bear the costs of disconnection and reconnection. If you have already paid or dispute the amount, contact the supplier at once using the phone number or email shown.
